doc: Measured cup tilt + rim height (viz/cup_rim.py): per pour, on the scene clock t [s] (= real_program.cup_poses t, t0_abs = take time of t = 0), the cup axis n = (n_x, n_y, sqrt(1 - n_x^2 - n_y^2)) in the cup frame F and s_m = the axial height [m] of the rim-top centre above the liquid-disc centre (smoothed, 20 Hz); raw = the per-frame fits.
